title: Crop cuts the wrong region on EXIF-rotated photos
description: cropExtended (services/imageCrop.js) crops the RAW pixel grid while the canvas and /image-import/probe show the photo upright. A phone photo shot portrait (EXIF orientation 5-8), imported under the reduce limit (copied untouched), is cut in the wrong place and written sideways. Hits single-card Crop and stack crop (MPI-949). Found in MPI-949 Phase 5; repro and fix sketch in brief.md.
